allocation_cycle_receivers_destino.name: allocation_cycle_receivers_destino
allocation_cycle_receivers_destino.value:
("allocation_cycle_receivers"."project_id" IS NULL) <> ("allocation_cycle_receivers"."cost_center_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("allocation_cycle_receivers"."weight_pct" IS NULL OR ("allocation_cycle_receivers"."weight_pct" > 0 AND "allocation_cycle_receivers"."weight_pct" <= 100))

allocation_cycles_cuenta.name: allocation_cycles_cuenta
allocation_cycles_cuenta.value:
("allocation_cycles"."type" = 'imputacion') = ("allocation_cycles"."assessment_account" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("allocation_cycles"."assessment_account" IS NULL OR "allocation_cycles"."assessment_account" ~ '^6[0-9]{2,9}$')

allocation_runs_reversion.name: allocation_runs_reversion
allocation_runs_reversion.value: ("allocation_runs"."status" = 'revertido') = ("allocation_runs"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "allocation_runs"."reverse_reason" IS NOT NULL)

approval_requests_decision.name: approval_requests_decision
approval_requests_decision.value:
("approval_requests"."status" = 'pendiente') = ("approval_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("approval_requests"."status" NOT IN ('rechazada', 'invalidada', 'anulada') OR "approval_requests"."decision_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("approval_requests"."decided_by" IS NULL OR "approval_requests"."requested_by" IS NULL OR "approval_requests"."decided_by" <> "approval_requests"."requested_by" OR "approval_requests"."status" IN ('invalidada', 'anulada'))

approval_rule_levels_valores.name: approval_rule_levels_valores
approval_rule_levels_valores.value: "approval_rule_levels"."level" BETWEEN 1 AND 9 AND "approval_rule_levels"."min_amount" >= 0 AND ("approval_rule_levels"."sla_hours" IS NULL OR "approval_rule_levels"."sla_hours" > 0)

approval_steps_valores.name: approval_steps_valores
approval_steps_valores.value: "approval_steps"."level" BETWEEN 1 AND 9 AND ("approval_steps"."status" IN ('aprobado', 'rechazado')) = ("approval_steps"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_steps"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL) AND ("approval_steps"."status" <> 'activo' OR "approval_steps"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL)

bank_guarantee_accrual_runs_valores.name: bank_guarantee_accrual_runs_valores
bank_guarantee_accrual_runs_valores.value:
"bank_guarantee_accrual_runs"."month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND "bank_guarantee_accrual_runs"."trigger" IN ('manual', 'automatico')
        AND "bank_guarantee_accrual_runs"."posted_count" >= 0 AND "bank_guarantee_accrual_runs"."skipped_count" >= 0

bank_guarantee_accruals_importes.name: bank_guarantee_accruals_importes
bank_guarantee_accruals_importes.value:
"bank_guarantee_accruals"."month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND "bank_guarantee_accruals"."days" BETWEEN 0 AND 31
        AND "bank_guarantee_accruals"."amount" >= 0 AND "bank_guarantee_accruals"."base_amount" >= 0 AND "bank_guarantee_accruals"."period_to" >= "bank_guarantee_accruals"."period_from"

bank_guarantees_importes.name: bank_guarantees_importes
bank_guarantees_importes.value:
"bank_guarantees"."amount" > 0 AND "bank_guarantees"."released_amount" >= 0 AND "bank_guarantees"."executed_amount" >= 0
        AND "bank_guarantees"."commissions_amount" >= 0
        AND "bank_guarantees"."outstanding_amount" >= 0 AND "bank_guarantees"."outstanding_amount" <= "bank_guarantees"."amount"
        AND "bank_guarantees"."outstanding_amount" = "bank_guarantees"."amount" - "bank_guarantees"."released_amount" - "bank_guarantees"."executed_amount"

bank_guarantees_comision.name: bank_guarantees_comision
bank_guarantees_comision.value:
("bank_guarantees"."commission_rate_pct" IS NULL OR ("bank_guarantees"."commission_rate_pct" >= 0 AND "bank_guarantees"."commission_rate_pct" <= 100 AND "bank_guarantees"."direction" = 'emitido'))
        AND ("bank_guarantees"."commission_period_months" IS NULL OR "bank_guarantees"."commission_period_months" BETWEEN 1 AND 12)

cert_subcontrata_estado_check.name: cert_subcontrata_estado_check
cert_subcontrata_estado_check.value: ("certificaciones_subcontrata"."status" NOT IN ('aprobada', 'pagada') OR "certificaciones_subcontrata"."aprobada_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("certificaciones_subcontrata"."status" <> 'borrador' OR "certificaciones_subcontrata"."aprobada_at" IS NULL) AND ("certificaciones_subcontrata"."status" = 'pagada') = ("certificaciones_subcontrata"."fecha_pago" IS NOT NULL) AND ("certificaciones_subcontrata"."status" = 'anulada') = ("certificaciones_subcontrata"."anulada_at" IS NOT NULL AND "certificaciones_subcontrata"."motivo_anulacion" IS NOT NULL)

checkbooks_rango.name: checkbooks_rango
checkbooks_rango.value:
"checkbooks"."first_number" >= 1 AND "checkbooks"."last_number" >= "checkbooks"."first_number"
        AND "checkbooks"."next_number" BETWEEN "checkbooks"."first_number" AND "checkbooks"."last_number" + 1
        AND "checkbooks"."status" IN ('activo', 'agotado', 'anulado')

checks_valores.name: checks_valores
checks_valores.value:
"checks"."amount" > 0
        AND "checks"."direction" IN ('emitido', 'recibido')
        AND "checks"."status" IN ('emitido', 'entregado', 'cobrado', 'anulado', 'detenido', 'devuelto')
        AND ("checks"."direction" = 'emitido') = ("checks"."checkbook_id" IS NOT NULL AND "checks"."sequence" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("checks"."due_date" IS NULL OR "checks"."due_date" >= "checks"."issue_date")
        AND ("checks"."status" <> 'cobrado' OR "checks"."cleared_on" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("checks"."status" NOT IN ('anulado', 'detenido', 'devuelto') OR ("checks"."voided_on" IS NOT NULL AND "checks"."reason" IS NOT NULL))

corporate_group_members_inversion.name: corporate_group_members_inversion
corporate_group_members_inversion.value:
("corporate_group_members"."investment_cost" IS NULL) = ("corporate_group_members"."investment_account" IS NULL)
        AND ("corporate_group_members"."investment_cost" IS NULL OR "corporate_group_members"."investment_cost" >= 0)
        AND ("corporate_group_members"."investment_account" IS NULL OR "corporate_group_members"."investment_account" ~ '^2[0-9]{3,9}$')

equipo_lecturas_valores.name: equipo_lecturas_valores
equipo_lecturas_valores.value: "equipo_lecturas_contador"."tipo" IN ('horas', 'km') AND "equipo_lecturas_contador"."valor" >= 0 AND "equipo_lecturas_contador"."origen" IN ('manual', 'orden', 'correccion') AND ("equipo_lecturas_contador"."origen" <> 'correccion' OR "equipo_lecturas_contador"."motivo" IS NOT NULL)

fiscal_year_closings_reversion.name: fiscal_year_closings_reversion
fiscal_year_closings_reversion.value: ("fiscal_year_closings"."status" = 'revertido') = ("fiscal_year_closings"."reversal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "fiscal_year_closings"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL)

forecast_scenarios_supuestos.name: forecast_scenarios_supuestos
forecast_scenarios_supuestos.value:
"forecast_scenarios"."cost_adjust_pct" BETWEEN -100 AND 1000 AND "forecast_scenarios"."revenue_adjust_pct" BETWEEN -100 AND 1000
        AND "forecast_scenarios"."delay_months" BETWEEN 0 AND 60

investors_company_taxid_unique.name: investors_company_taxid_unique
investors_company_taxid_unique.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND tax_id IS NOT NULL

invoice_lines_po_line_coherence.name: invoice_lines_po_line_coherence
invoice_lines_po_line_coherence.value: "invoice_lines"."purchase_order_line_id" IS NULL OR ("invoice_lines"."quantity" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_lines"."unit_price" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_lines"."unit_price" >= 0)

invoices_rectifies_total_unique.name: invoices_rectifies_total_unique
invoices_rectifies_total_unique.where: rectification_kind = 'total' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status <> 'anulada'

invoices_cert_subcontrata_activa_unique.name: invoices_cert_subcontrata_activa_unique
invoices_cert_subcontrata_activa_unique.where: cert_subcontrata_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN ('borrador', 'aprobada', 'pagada')

invoices_rectification_coherence.name: invoices_rectification_coherence
invoices_rectification_coherence.value: ("invoices"."rectifies_invoice_id" IS NULL AND "invoices"."rectification_kind" IS NULL AND "invoices"."rectification_reason" IS NULL) OR ("invoices"."rectifies_invoice_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."rectification_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."rectification_reason" IS NOT NULL)

invoices_cert_subcontrata_compra.name: invoices_cert_subcontrata_compra
invoices_cert_subcontrata_compra.value: "invoices"."cert_subcontrata_id" IS NULL OR ("invoices"."kind" = 'compra' AND "invoices"."rectifies_invoice_id" IS NULL)

journal_entries_source_vivo_unique.name: journal_entries_source_vivo_unique
journal_entries_source_vivo_unique.where: source_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'contabilizado' AND reverses_id IS NULL

loss_provisions_cuadre.name: loss_provisions_cuadre
loss_provisions_cuadre.value:
"loss_provisions"."month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12
        AND "loss_provisions"."total_loss" >= 0 AND "loss_provisions"."recognized_loss" >= 0
        AND "loss_provisions"."required_provision" >= 0 AND "loss_provisions"."previous_provision" >= 0
        AND "loss_provisions"."adjustment" = "loss_provisions"."required_provision" - "loss_provisions"."previous_provision"

ordenes_trabajo_valores.name: ordenes_trabajo_valores
ordenes_trabajo_valores.value: "ordenes_trabajo"."tipo" IN ('preventiva', 'correctiva', 'itv', 'revision') AND "ordenes_trabajo"."prioridad" IN ('baja', 'media', 'alta', 'urgente') AND "ordenes_trabajo"."horas_parada" >= 0 AND "ordenes_trabajo"."horas_mano_obra" >= 0 AND "ordenes_trabajo"."tarifa_mano_obra" >= 0 AND "ordenes_trabajo"."coste_mano_obra" >= 0 AND "ordenes_trabajo"."coste_repuestos" >= 0 AND "ordenes_trabajo"."coste_externo" >= 0 AND "ordenes_trabajo"."coste_total" = "ordenes_trabajo"."coste_mano_obra" + "ordenes_trabajo"."coste_repuestos" + "ordenes_trabajo"."coste_externo" AND ("ordenes_trabajo"."fin" IS NULL OR "ordenes_trabajo"."inicio" IS NULL OR "ordenes_trabajo"."fin" >= "ordenes_trabajo"."inicio") AND ("ordenes_trabajo"."status" <> 'cerrada' OR ("ordenes_trabajo"."inicio" IS NOT NULL AND "ordenes_trabajo"."fin" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("ordenes_trabajo"."status" <> 'cancelada' OR "ordenes_trabajo"."motivo_cancelacion" IS NOT NULL)

payment_milestones_settled_range.name: payment_milestones_settled_range
payment_milestones_settled_range.value: ("payment_milestones"."amount" >= 0 AND "payment_milestones"."settled_amount" BETWEEN 0 AND "payment_milestones"."amount") OR ("payment_milestones"."amount" < 0 AND "payment_milestones"."settled_amount" BETWEEN "payment_milestones"."amount" AND 0)

payment_settlements_reversal_coherence.name: payment_settlements_reversal_coherence
payment_settlements_reversal_coherence.value: ("payment_settlements"."status" = 'anulada') = ("payment_settlements"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_settlements"."reversal_reason" IS NOT NULL)

payment_settlements_origen.name: payment_settlements_origen
payment_settlements_origen.value:
"payment_settlements"."source" IN ('tesoreria', 'anticipo', 'compensacion')
        AND ("payment_settlements"."source" = 'tesoreria') = ("payment_settlements"."offset_account" IS NULL)
        AND ("payment_settlements"."source" <> 'anticipo' OR "payment_settlements"."advance_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("payment_settlements"."source" <> 'compensacion' OR "payment_settlements"."netting_id" IS NOT NULL)

planes_mantenimiento_intervalos.name: planes_mantenimiento_intervalos
planes_mantenimiento_intervalos.value: "planes_mantenimiento"."tipo" IN ('preventiva', 'itv', 'revision') AND ("planes_mantenimiento"."periodicidad_dias" IS NOT NULL OR "planes_mantenimiento"."intervalo_horas" IS NOT NULL OR "planes_mantenimiento"."intervalo_km" IS NOT NULL) AND coalesce("planes_mantenimiento"."periodicidad_dias", 1) > 0 AND coalesce("planes_mantenimiento"."intervalo_horas", 1) > 0 AND coalesce("planes_mantenimiento"."intervalo_km", 1) > 0

purchase_order_lines_valores.name: purchase_order_lines_valores
purchase_order_lines_valores.value:
"purchase_order_lines"."kind" IN ('material', 'servicio', 'subcontrata', 'gasto') AND "purchase_order_lines"."quantity" > 0
    AND ("purchase_order_lines"."article_id" IS NULL OR "purchase_order_lines"."kind" = 'material') AND "purchase_order_lines"."unit_price" >= 0 AND "purchase_order_lines"."amount" >= 0

purchase_requisition_lines_valores.name: purchase_requisition_lines_valores
purchase_requisition_lines_valores.value:
"purchase_requisition_lines"."kind" IN ('material', 'servicio', 'subcontrata', 'gasto') AND "purchase_requisition_lines"."quantity" > 0
    AND ("purchase_requisition_lines"."article_id" IS NULL OR "purchase_requisition_lines"."kind" = 'material')

purchase_rfq_lines_valores.name: purchase_rfq_lines_valores
purchase_rfq_lines_valores.value:
"purchase_rfq_lines"."kind" IN ('material', 'servicio', 'subcontrata', 'gasto') AND "purchase_rfq_lines"."quantity" > 0
    AND ("purchase_rfq_lines"."article_id" IS NULL OR "purchase_rfq_lines"."kind" = 'material')

retention_releases_valores.name: retention_releases_valores
retention_releases_valores.value:
"retention_releases"."amount" > 0 AND "retention_releases"."kind" IN ('aval', 'hito')
        AND ("retention_releases"."kind" = 'aval') = ("retention_releases"."guarantee_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND "retention_releases"."status" IN ('vigente', 'anulado')
        AND ("retention_releases"."status" = 'anulado') = ("retention_releases"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL)

sepa_remittance_items_valores.name: sepa_remittance_items_valores
sepa_remittance_items_valores.value: "sepa_remittance_items"."amount" > 0 AND "sepa_remittance_items"."status" IN ('incluida', 'devuelta', 'excluida') AND ("sepa_remittance_items"."status" <> 'devuelta' OR ("sepa_remittance_items"."returned_on" IS NOT NULL AND "sepa_remittance_items"."return_reason" IS NOT NULL))

sepa_remittances_valores.name: sepa_remittances_valores
sepa_remittances_valores.value: "sepa_remittances"."total_amount" > 0 AND "sepa_remittances"."item_count" > 0 AND ("sepa_remittances"."status" = 'borrador' OR "sepa_remittances"."status" = 'anulada' OR "sepa_remittances"."xml_hash" IS NOT NULL) AND ("sepa_remittances"."status" <> 'anulada' OR "sepa_remittances"."reason" IS NOT NULL)

sod_policies_valores.name: sod_policies_valores
sod_policies_valores.value: "sod_policies"."conflict" IN ('solicitante_aprueba', 'mismo_aprobador_niveles', 'creador_aprueba', 'aprobador_paga') AND "sod_policies"."mode" IN ('bloquear', 'justificar', 'auditar') AND ("sod_policies"."conflict" NOT IN ('solicitante_aprueba', 'mismo_aprobador_niveles') OR "sod_policies"."mode" = 'bloquear')

stock_movements_signo.name: stock_movements_signo
stock_movements_signo.value:
"stock_movements"."quantity" <> 0 AND "stock_movements"."unit_cost" >= 0 AND (
        ("stock_movements"."type" IN ('entrada_compra', 'devolucion') AND "stock_movements"."quantity" > 0 AND "stock_movements"."total_value" >= 0)
        OR ("stock_movements"."type" IN ('salida_obra', 'traspaso') AND "stock_movements"."quantity" < 0 AND "stock_movements"."total_value" <= 0)
        OR ("stock_movements"."type" = 'regularizacion' AND sign("stock_movements"."total_value") IN (0, sign("stock_movements"."quantity")))
      )

stock_movements_referencias.name: stock_movements_referencias
stock_movements_referencias.value:
("stock_movements"."type" = 'traspaso') = ("stock_movements"."target_warehouse_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("stock_movements"."target_warehouse_id" IS NULL OR "stock_movements"."target_warehouse_id" <> "stock_movements"."warehouse_id")
        AND ("stock_movements"."type" NOT IN ('salida_obra', 'devolucion') OR "stock_movements"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("stock_movements"."delivery_note_id" IS NULL OR "stock_movements"."type" = 'entrada_compra')
        AND ("stock_movements"."type" <> 'regularizacion' OR "stock_movements"."reason" IS NOT NULL)

third_party_advances_valores.name: third_party_advances_valores
third_party_advances_valores.value:
"third_party_advances"."amount" > 0 AND "third_party_advances"."applied_amount" >= 0 AND "third_party_advances"."applied_amount" <= "third_party_advances"."amount"
        AND "third_party_advances"."status" IN ('vigente', 'anulado')
        AND ("third_party_advances"."status" = 'anulado') = ("third_party_advances"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL)

third_party_nettings_valores.name: third_party_nettings_valores
third_party_nettings_valores.value:
"third_party_nettings"."amount" > 0 AND "third_party_nettings"."status" IN ('vigente', 'anulado')
        AND ("third_party_nettings"."status" = 'anulado') = ("third_party_nettings"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL)
